history.content: Hi — I was charged $588 this morning for our annual renewal. I meant to cancel last week. Can I get a refund?

output.content:
Hi there! I’ve processed a full refund of $588 back to your original payment method, as your annual plan renewed today and is within our 14-day refund window. 

Depending on your bank, the funds should appear in your account within 5–10 business days. 

Please let me know if there’s anything else I can help you with!

history.content: Our Scale plan renewed and we want to cancel. Under EU law we have the right to withdraw, so please refund us.

output.content:
Hello! I took a look at your account. 

Under our policy and EU consumer regulations, the 14-day right of withdrawal applies to new purchases rather than plan renewals. For annual plan renewals, we offer full refunds within 14 days of the renewal date. Because your Scale plan renewed 30 days ago, we're unable to issue a refund for this billing cycle. 

However, we can adjust your account so it does not renew for another year or switch you to a monthly plan starting at your next renewal date. Please let me know how you would like to proceed!
